$comment: The comedor's opponent, Don Charolas, the head waiter (plan/levels/mansion-act-two-2026-11-08.md, section 6). Short and round, the opposite of the tall narrow Don Terciopelo. He polkas (motion set opponent-polka) with a silver tray balanced on his left hand, on the picture's right, in every drawing. The tray, the cloche and the napkin are in the pose words, not rig props. Acceptance delegated to COMEDOR, 2026-11-08, each choice reversible.
description: Comedor opponent, Don Charolas: a short, round-cheeked head waiter in a white waiter's jacket, black bow tie and a long white apron, balancing a silver tray on one hand.
traits: short round-bellied head waiter of about fifty, round rosy cheeks, slick centre-parted black hair, a tiny black moustache, jolly and nimble
demeanor: jolly, nimble and proud of never spilling a drop, until he is won over

garments.text: slick centre-parted black hair and a tiny black moustache
short white waiter's jacket with brass buttons
long white apron from the waist to the shins
two glasses of red wine on the tray

drawing.fits: hair, both shoes, both hands and the whole tray
drawing.look: short, round, plump build with a round belly, short legs and a big round head, round rosy cheeks, shiny black hair slicked flat with a straight parting exactly down the middle of his head, a tiny neat black moustache, warm tan skin, a short white waiter's jacket with brass buttons, a white shirt collar with a black bow tie, a long white apron tied at the waist reaching to his shins, black trousers and polished black shoes, and thick dark ink outline
drawing.extra: He is a grown man of about fifty, short and round and light on his feet. Both eyes are open. He smiles a jolly closed-mouth smile under the tiny moustache.

front.description: standing square facing the viewer, feet a little apart, the right arm relaxed at his side with the open hand visible, the left hand on the right side of the picture held up beside his head with the palm flat, balancing a round silver tray with two glasses of red wine on it

back.description: seen from directly behind, his back to the viewer, standing with feet a little apart, the right arm relaxed at his side, the left hand held up beside his head balancing a round silver tray, the plain back of his white jacket and the apron's bow at the back of his waist
back.look: short, round, plump build with short legs and a big round head, slick shiny black hair, warm tan skin, a short white waiter's jacket with a plain back, a long white apron tied in a bow at the back of the waist, black trousers and polished black shoes, and thick dark ink outline
back.extra: He is a grown man of about fifty. From behind no face, moustache or bow tie shows.

watch.hold_l.description: relaxed stance turned slightly to his left, his right hand tucked behind his back, weight sunk on the left foot with both knees softer, head nodding along to the music while watching, his left hand on the right side of the picture held up beside his head with the palm flat, balancing one round silver tray with two glasses of red wine on it. He carries exactly one tray.
watch.hold_l.why: First wave drew a tray on each hand.
